_comment: A registry used only by the tests. The shipped registry.json is operator data, meant to be
edited, so tests that assert on its contents break whenever somebody adds or removes a list,
and their coverage quietly shrinks with it. This fixture holds the cases the query rules of
TS 103 770 clause 5.1.3.2 need: two providers, a regulator list and a non-regulator one,
overlapping and non-overlapping countries, and more than one delivery type.
